allowed_sentences: Against 2360 measured decay-heat points from 132 JAEA FNS experiments, ACTINV with its shipped TENDL-2025 data has a median |ln C/E| of 0.139; OpenMC 0.15.3 depletion with its published ENDF/B-VIII.1 fast-spectrum depletion chain (chain_endfb81_fast.xml) and ENDF/B-VIII.1 has 0.316.
Given the same ENDF/B-VIII.1 cross sections as OpenMC, ACTINV has a median |ln C/E| of 0.234 on the same points.
With isomer branching ratios from the ENDF/B-VIII.1 library added to that chain, OpenMC has a median |ln C/E| of 0.252 on the 2360 of those points it covers.

With a chain built from ENDF/B-VIII.0 decay data and TENDL-2025 reaction channels instead (Chain.from_endf, ground-state targets), OpenMC has a median |ln C/E| of 0.311 on the 2358 of those points it covers.
verdict: P172-PASS (pending G4, CI on the evidence commit)
